title: Clerk sign-up card
description: A mock sign-in / sign-up form built from divs: bold centred title, small muted subtitle, hairline provider buttons (one with a 'last used' tag), an 'or' rule, labelled fields (one can type itself in), a graphite submit button and a grey footer strip with a link.
notes: purely visual: nothing submits. The typing field is a CSS animation (off with reduced motion)
